summary: Backend testing for webhook-first booking flow. All 7 pytest cases passed. Verified: (1) POST /api/booking returns 503 on preview (calendar not connected) while the CRM webhook has already fired to LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL (httpbin) with status 200/ok=true; (2) payload field formatting is exact — first_name='Marcus', last_name='Bennett', full_name, email, phone, company, industry='Roofing', notes, appointment_date human-readable (weekday, month day, year), appointment_time='2:00 PM', appointment_timezone='America/Toronto', appointment_start_iso with -04:00/-05:00 offset, appointment_when combined, source='Lead-Generation.ca', submitted_at present; (3) Validation runs BEFORE webhook: invalid time '11:30' returns 400 and does NOT update _last_webhook (confirmed by sentinel marker); past date returns 400; (4) GET /api/booking/last-webhook returns 200 with WEBHOOK_DEBUG=true; (5) Sanity: root, availability (4 days x 3 slots at 10:00/14:00/16:00), oauth status configured=true.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _last_webhook is a module-level dict, not thread-safe under concurrent bookings — acceptable for a debug/observability aid but note for production.

_fire_webhook uses synchronous requests wrapped in asyncio.to_thread — fine, but a 10s timeout still blocks the booking response by up to 10s per request. Consider fire-and-forget task if latency matters.

create_booking builds the Booking and fires the webhook BEFORE checking _calendar_ready(), which correctly satisfies the requirement, but this means webhooks will fire for every valid-slot POST even when calendar is permanently offline — expected behavior per spec.
GET /api/booking/last-webhook exposes raw lead PII (name/email/phone) when WEBHOOK_DEBUG=true. Ensure WEBHOOK_DEBUG stays false in production.
seed_data_creation: None — bookings are in-memory and calendar creation intentionally 503s on preview.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview env has LEAD_WEBHOOK_URL=https://httpbin.org/post, WEBHOOK_DEBUG=true, and Google Calendar intentionally disconnected (bookings return 503 by design after webhook fires). Do not attempt Google OAuth. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_webhook_first.py.
